repair_note: cellular retinoic acid-binding protein 1-like. Single hit.
forkhead box protein D3-A-like. Second FoxD3 entry in the annotation; both are kept because which one is transcribed here is not known.

HNK-1 is a carbohydrate epitope, not a transcript. B3GAT1 is the glucuronyltransferase that builds it. Expression of the enzyme is a proxy for the epitope, and the epitope also needs the sulfotransferase CHST10.
homeobox protein MSX-2. The annotation has no MSX1. Lamprey carries a single Msx, so this entry stands for both requests.
paired box 7. The annotation has no PAX3. Lamprey carries a single Pax3/7, so this entry stands for both requests. NOTE: this is also the only gene in the S1 sheet's Spermatogonial stem cells set.
TNF receptor superfamily member 16-like, second entry.
TNF receptor superfamily member 16-like, third entry.
transcription factor Sox-9-A. The annotation has no SOX10. The lamprey SoxE genes are the SOX9/SOX10 counterparts, so all three SoxE entries stand for both requests.
transcription factor AP-2-beta. The annotation has no TFAP2A. TFAP2D is present and belongs to a different subfamily, so it is not included.
zinc finger protein ZIC 1-like, second entry. ZIC2 and ZIC4 are present and are not included.
